title: Notable Effort
description: Accepting good effort as a valid reason to accept the truth of the conclusion, even though the effort is unrelated to the truth.
logical_form:
Person 1 made a notable effort to prove Y.

Therefore, Y is true.

examples.example: Judge: In all my years as a federal judge I have never seen a defendant make such a good effort to prove his innocence.  As a result, I rule for the defendant.
examples.explanation: The fact that the defendant made a good effort to prove his innocence means nothing to the fact that he is actually innocent or not—unless he *succeeded *in his efforts.  The judge's ruling would be based on emotion and not reason.

examples.example: How can you possibly deny his claim?  William wrote an entire book trying to explain why he thinks his claim is true.  Therefore, it must be true.
examples.explanation: The fact that William made a *notable effort* to prove his claim does not mean that he did.

exceptions: As long as the effort is unrelated to the truth of the claim, there are no exceptions.
tips: Enough with the “everyone’s a winner” mentality.  As long as we keep rewarding *all* effort, we devalue the effort that leads to *successful results*.  The world needs losers as well -- just don’t be one of them.
references: This a logical fallacy frequently used on the Internet. No academic sources could be found.
description_et: Hea pingutuse aktsepteerimine kui mõjuv põhjus järelduse tõesuse aktsepteerimiseks, isegi kui pingutus pole tõega seotud.
logical_form_et:
Isik 1 tegi märkimisväärseid jõupingutusi, et tõestada Y.

Seetõttu on Y tõsi.
exceptions_et: Seni, kuni pingutus ei ole väite tõepärasusega seotud, pole erandeid.
tips_et: Piisab "igaüks on võitja" mentaliteedist.  Kuni me tasume *kõiki* pingutusi, devalveerime *edukate tulemusteni* viivat pingutust.  Maailm vajab ka kaotajaid – lihtsalt ära ole üks neist.

examples_et.example: Kohtunik: Kõigi oma föderaalkohtunikuna töötatud aastate jooksul pole ma kunagi näinud, et kostja oleks nii hästi pingutanud, et tõestada oma süütust.  Sellest tulenevalt otsustan ma kostja eest.
examples_et.explanation: Asjaolu, et kostja tegi oma süütuse tõestamiseks tublisid jõupingutusi, ei tähenda midagi selle kohta, kas ta on tegelikult süütu või mitte – välja arvatud juhul, kui ta *tema püüdlused õnnestus.  Kohtuniku otsus põhineks emotsioonil, mitte mõistusel.

examples_et.original_explanation: The fact that the defendant made a good effort to prove his innocence means nothing to the fact that he is actually innocent or not—unless he *succeeded *in his efforts.  The judge's ruling would be based on emotion and not reason.

examples_et.example: Kuidas saate tema väidet eitada?  William kirjutas terve raamatu, püüdes selgitada, miks ta arvab, et tema väide on tõsi.  Seetõttu peab see tõsi olema.
examples_et.explanation: Asjaolu, et William tegi oma väite tõestamiseks *märkimisväärseid jõupingutusi*, ei tähenda, et ta seda tegi.
